items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-20
items.q: What's his name? Can you remember? Henderson something, I can't think of it.

ctx.x: There's one over here. That was for Ethel gas. This is for Ethel gas again. This is something else. Here's Cherville 1934. It was on this boat. Supposedly on a boat. This was a big app for Chesapeake Church. Chesterfield cigarettes and this for Chesterfield. There you go, different ads that he did. He did a lot of ads. He was a charter member of the Lambs Club. Now this guy, he's on a program as a world trans. And he looks very much like my uncle. You see the resemblance? Yeah. And I sent him a picture of my…
Looks like a Roth or something. Henderson something.
